title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #12

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the most famous sacred river in Hindu teaching? (1 mark)
   A. Ganga
   B. Tana
   C. Nzoia
   D. Athi

2. Which tree is linked with Guru Nanak Dev Ji at Sultanpur Lodhi? (1 mark)
   A. Sal tree
   B. Tulsi
   C. Ber (Beri) tree
   D. Bodhi tree

3. In the story of the swan, who shot the swan? (1 mark)
   A. Suddhodana
   B. Devadatta
   C. Prahlad
   D. Siddhartha

4. Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev
   B. Mahavir
   C. The Buddha
   D. Valmiki

5. Which of these were sons of King Dasharatha? (1 mark)
   A. Prahlad, Ram and Jetha
   B. Lakshman, Devadatta, Ram and Bharat
   C. Ram, Sigala, Bharat and Shibi
   D. Ram, Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughna

6. A child promises to return a friend's book on time. Which scripture lesson is being followed? (1 mark)
   A. Not stealing, as in Rijubalika
   B. Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   C. Sitting on heels
   D. Making a fast

7. Who first compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   B. Guru Ram Das Ji
   C. Mahavir
   D. Valmiki

8. What could you use to map the Mandirs in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A random guess
   C. A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   D. A dream

9. Which prayer starts with the words Twameva mata cha pita twameva? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   B. Gayatri Mantra
   C. Saraswati Vandana
   D. Om Namah Shivaya

10. What does the white colour of Saraswati stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Hunger
   B. Purity and peace
   C. Anger
   D. Heat

11. What are bhajans? (1 mark)
   A. Maps
   B. Exams
   C. Devotional songs
   D. Sports

12. Which goddess is Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Goddess of war
   B. Goddess of the river Ganga
   C. Goddess of fire
   D. Goddess of knowledge and learning

13. What does mata mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. Father
   C. Friend
   D. Mother

14. Who should you give up your seat to? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. A friend
   C. An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   D. The loudest passenger

15. Which statement about integrity is true? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for adults
   B. It is only for big things
   C. It includes small daily choices
   D. It is only for teachers

16. Which is honest behaviour with technology? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your personal details with strangers
   B. Asking permission before using a device
   C. Sending unkind messages
   D. Copying someone's work

17. How should the back be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Round
   B. Straight
   C. Bent
   D. Twisted

18. What does asana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A song
   C. A posture or seat
   D. A river

19. What should you do if your knees hurt in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Stay for an hour
   B. Push harder
   C. Ignore it
   D. Stop and come out of the pose

20. What does Kama mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. Cruelty
   C. War
   D. Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship

21. Which is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   B. Being kind to animals
   C. Praying
   D. Being honest

22. What does Artha mean? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. War
   C. A river
   D. Honest wealth and the things we need

23. What does the Vedic saying say about the truth? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for kings
   B. It has many separate truths
   C. It is unknown
   D. It is one but is called by many names

24. Why do the dates of Maha Shivratri and Paryushan change on the usual calendar? (1 mark)
   A. They follow the Moon
   B. They follow the market days
   C. They follow the shops
   D. They follow the school terms

25. Maha Shivratri means what? (1 mark)
   A. The great day of the Sun
   B. The festival of lights
   C. The great night of Shiva
   D. The day of forgiveness

26. Which is a reason for celebrating festivals? (1 mark)
   A. To remember important events and teachings
   B. To stop learning
   C. To avoid friends
   D. To waste time

27. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Dislike of others
   B. Love for sweets
   C. Love for one's country
   D. Fear of others

28. What does Micchami Dukkadam mean? (1 mark)
   A. May any harm I did be forgiven
   B. Good morning
   C. Thank you for the food
   D. Happy birthday

29. What is the Indian name for Friday? (1 mark)
   A. Shukravaar
   B. Budhvaar
   C. Somvaar
   D. Guruvaar

30. What is the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of tree
   B. The Indian traditional calendar book
   C. A river
   D. A prayer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the seven days of the week in the Indian traditional calendar with their heavenly bodies. (4 marks)

32. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

33. Why are Enlightened Beings considered inspiring? Use two examples. (5 marks)

34. Name the four Enlightened Beings studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

35. Describe how Hindu families care for the Tulsi plant. (3 marks)

36. Describe how Sikhs show respect to Guru Granth Sahib Ji in a gurdwara. (3 marks)

37. Explain why respect for a Mandir is important and how a visitor of any faith can show it. (5 marks)

38. Write the Indian names for Tuesday and Wednesday. (2 marks)

39. What is a rite or ritual? Give one example. (2 marks)

40. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

41. Explain how to say the Gayatri Mantra correctly. (3 marks)

42. Give two benefits of daily prayer. (2 marks)

43. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

44. What is a Tirthankar? (2 marks)

45. Write the Indian names for Sunday and Monday. (2 marks)

46. State two things people do on Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Ganga
   The Ganga in India is honoured by many Hindus.

2. C — Ber (Beri) tree
   The Ber Sahib stands beside a gurdwara in Sultanpur Lodhi.

3. B — Devadatta
   Devadatta shot an arrow at the swan.

4. C — The Buddha
   The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

5. D — Ram, Bharat, Lakshman and Shatrughna
   These were the four brothers.

6. B — Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   Ram kept promises.

7. A — Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   Guru Arjan Dev Ji was the fifth Guru.

8. C — A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   We can use a map on a tablet.

9. A — Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   It begins with these words.

10. B — Purity and peace
   White is a sign of purity.

11. C — Devotional songs
   Bhajans are songs of prayer.

12. D — Goddess of knowledge and learning
   Saraswati is the goddess of learning.

13. D — Mother
   Mata means mother and pita means father.

14. C — An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   Helping those who need seats shows kindness.

15. C — It includes small daily choices
   Small choices count.

16. B — Asking permission before using a device
   Permission is part of responsible use.

17. B — Straight
   A straight back is important.

18. C — A posture or seat
   An asana is a posture.

19. D — Stop and come out of the pose
   Do not force the body.

20. D — Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship
   Kama is good and healthy desire.

21. A — Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   Children can practise Dharma too.

22. D — Honest wealth and the things we need
   Artha is earning in an honest way.

23. D — It is one but is called by many names
   The truth is one, the wise call it by many names.

24. A — They follow the Moon
   The Indian calendar is based on the Moon.

25. C — The great night of Shiva
   Maha means great and ratri means night.

26. A — To remember important events and teachings
   Festivals help us remember.

27. C — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love for our country.

28. A — May any harm I did be forgiven
   It is a plea for forgiveness.

29. A — Shukravaar
   Shukra is Venus.

30. B — The Indian traditional calendar book
   It lists days, months and festival dates.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ravivaar: Sun; Somvaar: Moon; Mangalvaar: Mars; Budhvaar: Mercury; Guruvaar: Jupiter; Shukravaar: Venus; Shanivaar: Saturn.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for every two correct pairs, up to 4.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Their lives show courage, kindness and truth. For example, Prahlad's faith and Siddhartha's kindness to the swan. People follow their example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for each example, up to 5.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha (Prince Siddhartha) and Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: They grow it in a pot or a stand in the courtyard, water it every morning, walk around it and pray. Its leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna and used in home medicine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 3.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is placed on a raised seat; people cover their heads, remove shoes and bow before it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: A Mandir is a holy place. Visitors can remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, ask before photos and accept prasad politely. Respect brings peace among faiths.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holy place, 3 marks for three ways, 1 mark for peace.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tuesday: Mangalvaar. Wednesday: Budhvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special action done in a set way at a festival, such as lighting a lamp or raising a flag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly with a straight back, close eyes and breathe slowly, say it one line at a time and listen first to a teacher or recording so you copy the sounds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us start the day calmly, teaches discipline, makes us thankful and gives peace of mind (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Jain teacher who shows people the path to freedom, like a guide across a river.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teacher, 1 mark for showing the path.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sunday: Ravivaar. Monday: Somvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fast, stay awake all night, bathe the Shiva Linga, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
